title: A separated scheme covered by n+1 affines has affine stratification number at most n
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma bounds the affine stratification number (the minimal length of a finite stratification by locally closed affine subschemes with affine closures, per the chapter's definition) of a separated scheme X in terms of the size of an affine open cover: n+1 affines give stratification number <= n. The retained proof is written: with X = U_0 union ... union U_n, set X_i = (U_i union ... union U_n) \ (U_{i+1} union ... union U_n); each X_i is a locally closed piece realized as a closed subscheme of the affine U_i (the difference of two quasi-compact opens in a separated scheme is closed), the stratum map X_i -> X is affine by permanence (Morphisms, lemma affine-permanence: composition of the closed immersion into U_i with the affine open immersion), and the closure condition closure(X_i) subset X_i union ... union X_0 is the bookkeeping identity that makes {X_i} an affine stratification. Retained author proof at lines 21595-21605.
